problem: Urban sanitation challenges, particularly the lack of effective non-networked sanitation systems in growing cities.
solution: Integration of urban sanitation and wastewater management into academic curricula through training programs, course development, and research initiatives under SCBP.
technology: Discussion on appropriate wastewater treatment technologies, decentralized systems, and operationally feasible solutions for cities.
outcome: Collaboration between academia and sector experts to develop educational programs, research, and capacity-building efforts for sustainable urban sanitation.
